title: User Login with Valid Credentials and Role-Based Access
description: Verify that a user can log in with valid credentials and is granted correct permissions based on assigned role.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter valid username and password for each role (DEVELOPER, ADMIN, MANAGER, STAFF)
Click on login button
Verify user is authenticated and redirected to dashboard
Verify that UI elements and features reflect correct access permissions for the user's role

title: User Login Failure with Invalid Credentials
description: Ensure user cannot login with invalid username or password and is shown an appropriate error message.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter invalid username or password
Click login button
Verify login is rejected and an error message is displayed

title: Dashboard Data Accuracy and Refresh
description: Verify the dashboard displays accurate livestock metrics, financial summaries, and interactive charts with up-to-date data.

steps.description: Login as a user with dashboard access
Navigate to dashboard page
Verify key performance indicators and financial summaries match backend data
Trigger data changes (e.g., add livestock or record transaction)
Refresh or revisit dashboard
Verify dashboard reflects updated data correctly

title: Barn Management CRUD Operations
description: Test Create, Read, Update, and Delete operations on barns including capacity and occupancy validation.

steps.description: Navigate to barn management page
Create a new barn with valid data (name, capacity)
Verify new barn is listed and saved correctly
Edit existing barn details and update capacity
Verify changes are saved and reflected in barn list
Attempt to delete a barn with no assigned livestock
Verify barn is deleted successfully
Attempt to delete a barn with assigned livestock
Verify deletion is prevented or warns user appropriately

title: Livestock Management and Status Update
description: Verify livestock batch and individual animal creation, status updates, barn assignment, and opening balance management.

steps.description: Navigate to livestock management page
Add a new livestock batch with valid attributes, including type and quantity
Verify new batch is listed and details correct
Update status of individual livestock (e.g. sold, deceased)
Verify status change is saved and visually indicated
Assign livestock to barns and update occupancy
Verify barn capacity updates accordingly
Set opening balances and verify accurate calculations

title: Livestock Types CRUD Management
description: Test creation, update, deletion, and listing of different livestock types (Cow, Sheep, Goat, Chicken, etc.).

steps.description: Navigate to livestock types management page
Create a new livestock type with required details
Verify livestock type is added successfully
Edit livestock type details
Verify updates are saved correctly
Attempt to delete livestock type in use by existing livestock
Verify system prevents deletion or warns user

title: Purchase Workflow and Livestock Creation Automation
description: Verify purchase creation with supplier and payment details, draft to confirmed workflow and automatic livestock record creation.

steps.description: Navigate to purchase management page
Create a new purchase record with supplier, livestock details, and payment information
Verify purchase is saved as draft initially
Confirm the purchase
Verify purchase status updates to confirmed
Verify livestock records are created automatically based on purchase data
Attempt purchase creation with missing mandatory fields
Verify validation errors are displayed and purchase not saved

title: Sales Management with POS and Deferred Payments
description: Validate sales processing through POS and deferred payment options including invoice and receipt generation.

steps.description: Navigate to sales POS interface
Process an immediate sale with valid livestock and payment data
Verify sale is recorded, livestock status updated, and receipt generated correctly
Navigate to deferred sales page
Create a deferred sale with installment plan
Verify sale pending payments and invoice generated
Make payment installment and verify partial payment tracking
Verify payment is recorded and receipt issued
Attempt to create sale without required fields
Verify form validation prevents submission

title: Islamic Charitable Vows (Nadhr) Recording and Receipt Generation
description: Test recording of donated livestock for vows with donor information and generation of donation receipts.

steps.description: Navigate to vows management page
Record a new vow with donor data and livestock details
Verify vow is saved and visible in list
Generate and print receipt for vow donation
Verify receipt contains accurate donor and livestock info

title: Financial Contributions Tracking and Multi-Wallet Payment
description: Verify capability to track cash donations split across multiple wallets and generate donor receipts.

steps.description: Access contributions management page
Create a new financial contribution specifying multiple wallets for payment distribution
Verify contribution is recorded with correct wallet balances updated
Generate and view receipt for donor
Verify receipt has complete and accurate contribution data

title: Expense Management with Categorization and Payment Support
description: Test adding, editing, and categorizing operating expenses and handling payments with wallet selection.

steps.description: Navigate to expense management section
Add operating expense categorized under Feed with valid payment details and wallet
Verify expense is saved and wallet balance updated
Edit existing expense and change category and payment wallet
Verify updates persist and wallet balances are correct
Attempt to add expense without mandatory fields
Verify validation errors appear and expense not saved

title: Wallet and Cash Register Management with Real-Time Balances
description: Verify wallet creation, balance tracking, and detailed transaction history correctness.

steps.description: Navigate to wallets page
Create a new wallet with initial balance
Verify wallet appears in list with correct balance
Perform transactions affecting wallet balance (income and expenses)
Verify wallet balance updates in real-time
View wallet transaction history
Verify all transactions are listed accurately and chronologically

title: User Management with Role Assignment and Password Handling
description: Verify user creation, role assignment, permission overrides, and password reset functionality.

steps.description: Navigate to user management page
Create a new user with assigned role and custom permissions
Verify user is listed with correct roles and permissions
Edit user to change role and permissions
Verify changes saved and reflected in user access
Initiate password reset for user
Verify password reset process completes successfully
Attempt unauthorized role modifications by non-admin user
Verify system prevents unauthorized changes

title: Report Generation with Filters, Export, and Print
description: Validate daily, advanced, and livestock movement reports generation with filtering, exporting, and printing capabilities.

steps.description: Navigate to report hub and select daily report
Apply date range and category filters
Verify report data matches filters and is accurate
Export daily report in supported formats (PDF, CSV)
Verify exported file opens and contains correct data
Print report preview
Verify print layout is correct and complete
Repeat above steps for advanced and livestock movement reports

title: Settlement System Daily Close-Out and Audit Logging
description: Test performing daily settlement including wallet balance snapshots, logging settlements actions, and reviewing history.

steps.description: Navigate to settlement page
Perform daily settlement close-out
Verify wallet balances are captured and settlement recorded
Verify audit log captures settlement action with user and timestamp
View settlement history
Verify historical settlement records display correctly with details

title: Audit Logging Captures User and System Activities
description: Verify audit log records all critical user actions and system changes including login events, data CRUDs, and settlements.

steps.description: Perform a series of actions: login, barn CRUD, purchase creation, sale processing, and settlement
Navigate to audit logs page
Verify each action is logged with correct user, timestamp, action type, and affected entities

title: Database Backup and Restore Workflow
description: Verify system can perform MySQL database backup and restore operations without data loss or corruption.

steps.description: Navigate to backup management page
Trigger a database backup
Verify backup file is created and download available
Perform restore operation from a valid backup file
Verify database state matches backed up data with no corruption
Attempt restore with invalid or corrupted backup file
Verify system rejects restore and shows error

title: Global Search Accuracy and Performance
description: Test global search feature returns accurate, relevant results efficiently across all system entities.

steps.description: Navigate to global search interface
Enter varied search queries for barns, livestock, users, purchases, sales, and reports
Verify search results include relevant matching records
Verify response time remains within acceptable performance thresholds

title: Settings Management for Roles and Permissions
description: Verify role and permission configurations can be modified and applied correctly to users system-wide.

steps.description: Navigate to settings management page
Edit a user role's permissions, adding and removing rights
Verify changes are saved and enforced immediately
Assign modified roles to users and test access restrictions
Verify users gain or lose features as per updated permissions

title: UI Components Render Consistently and Responsively
description: Verify the application UI components including forms, buttons, tables, dialogs, and charts render correctly and maintain usability across devices and browsers.

steps.description: Navigate through the application on desktop browser
Verify all UI components render without layout issues or visual glitches
Access the application on mobile device and simulate different screen sizes
Verify UI components adjust layout responsively and remain functional
Test key UI interactions like modals, dropdowns, and forms
Verify smooth interaction and accessibility compliance

title: Theme Toggle Dark/Light Mode Functionality
description: Verify application toggles between dark and light modes smoothly without layout breakages or loss of functionality.

steps.description: Locate and activate the theme toggle control
Verify UI switches to dark mode correctly with consistent styling
Toggle back to light mode
Verify UI returns to light mode with consistent styling
Perform several UI interactions while toggling themes
Verify no UI components break or display inconsistently

title: Session and PWA Support Preserve User State
description: Verify that client-side session management and PWA installation preserve user authentication state and settings between sessions and page reloads.

steps.description: Login to the application and perform various actions
Reload the page or close and re-open tab
Verify user remains logged in and session is maintained
Install application as PWA on supported device
Verify app launches correctly with user state preserved
Test offline behavior by disconnecting from network
Verify PWA delivers expected offline functionality or error messages

title: Performance Monitoring Metrics collection & threshold compliance
description: Test the collection of API performance metrics including timing, averages, and percentile statistics and validate compliance with responsiveness thresholds.

steps.description: Perform typical user operations across modules (login, CRUD, reports)
Access performance monitoring interface or logs
Verify metrics are recorded with operation timing and statistics
Validate that recorded performance values meet defined responsiveness thresholds
